_metadata.phase: Nationwide Facilities / Step 1; source_system_identification, authoritative_source_research and the delivery correction added by the Step 4 provenance investigation
_metadata.note: What is established about the supplied source, and what is NOT. Fields marked not_established are recorded that way deliberately: the dataset arrived with no accompanying documentation, and inferring an organisation, a licence or a coverage claim from a filename would be inventing provenance rather than recording it. Version 2 adds evidence gathered by the provenance investigation of 2026-09-14; every conclusion drawn from that evidence is labelled inference where it is one.

file.supplied_as: nigeria_health_facilities.csv, placed at the repository root
file.format: CSV, UTF-8, no BOM, CRLF line terminators
file.structure: One title line ('nigeria_health_facilities'), then a 90-column header, then 31,390 data rows. All rows are exactly 90 fields wide. 284 bare LF characters occur inside quoted fields; the CSV parses cleanly.
file.filesystem_mtime: 2026-08-06T17:44:49 (local machine, not authoritative for the dataset)

fingerprint.purpose: Reproducible identity of this exact file — header, row count, null pattern, state counts, identifier sets, timestamps, per-state coordinate-orientation signature and canonical sample hashes — so a pristine export supplied by the owner (AUTH-09) can be compared against the copy this repository was handed.

retention_policy.basis: facilities/source/ is this repository's established raw-source location and already holds committed upstream CSVs: GRID3_NGA_health_facilities_v2_0_*.csv (13,613,859 bytes) and hotosm_nga_health_facilities.csv (1,225,666 bytes). Retaining source bytes there is existing policy, not a new one.

source_organization.what_the_file_says: Nothing. There is no organisation name, publisher field, copyright line or contact anywhere in the 90 columns or the title row.
source_organization.why_not_asserted: established/recorded_name follow the AUTH-01 evidence standard: a document or correspondence FROM the owner naming the organisation. That has not been received. The investigation's identification of the source system (see source_system_identification) is evidence-backed but is not owner confirmation, so these fields do not claim it.

source_system_identification.identified_system: Nigeria Health Facility Registry (NHFR), operated by the Federal Ministry of Health, Nigeria (hfr.fmohconnect.gov.ng)
source_system_identification.classification: INFERENCE from structural and identifier congruence — strong, reproducible in this repository, and still not a substitute for the owner's written confirmation (AUTH-01).

evidence.identifier_congruence: unique_id uses the six-segment facility-code shape NN/NN/N/N/N/NNNN. The repository's independently sourced GRID3 CSV (CC BY 4.0, hash-pinned) carries the columns nhfr_uid and nhfr_facility_code, labels their source NHFR_2024, and uses the identical shape. 12,619 of the 31,390 unique_id values match a GRID3 nhfr_facility_code exactly; the two snapshots are roughly two years apart, which bounds the overlap below. Reproducible: facilities/source/nhf_source_fingerprint_v1.json, grid3_cross_reference.
evidence.record_level_corroboration: For rows joinable on the facility code, GRID3's independently published coordinate for the same NHFR facility lies within 20 km of this file's (orientation-corrected) pair 3,005 times and of the pair as given 2 times (reports/facilities_coordinate_audit_v1.json).
evidence.schema_congruence: The 90 columns include registry-workflow fields (requested_by/verified_by/validated_by/published_by with *_at and *_note), dhis2_synced, and facility-code and state-code identifiers — the shape of a facility-registry backend, not of a hand-built spreadsheet.
evidence.schema_implication: Those workflow and audit columns (created_by, verify_note, action, the seven empty officer-contact columns) are internal registry-side fields. INFERENCE: this is a registry-side database export, not the output of the registry's public search pages or documented public API. Whoever produced it had, or obtained, registry-side access; the public channel this copy came through is not established.

source_system_identification.what_this_does_not_establish: Which NHFR export produced this file, when, by whom, under what authority, and whether the bytes were altered en route (the copy demonstrably passed through Apple Numbers). AUTH-09 remains open.

authoritative_source_research.method: Direct fetches of the registry's own pages. No third-party summary, repost or undocumented licence claim is relied on for any statement below.

registry.name: Nigeria Health Facility Registry (HFR)
registry.copyright_footer_verbatim: Copyright ©2026 Federal Ministry of Health. All Rights Reserved

contact.address: New Federal Secretariat Complex, Ahmadu Bello Way, Central Business District

authoritative_source_research.licence_finding: No terms of use, licence, data-reuse policy, attribution instruction or data dictionary was found on the landing page or the developers page. The only rights statement present is the All-Rights-Reserved copyright footer. Consequence: the registry's own public statements grant nothing; reuse permission must come from the Ministry in writing.

api.access_model: RESTful API; key required (X-API-Key header); key issued via a request form, 'approval is typically within 24 hours'.
api.bulk_export: No bulk export or CSV download is documented on the developers page.

other_channels_checked.hfr.health.gov.ng: Legacy domain; TLS certificate is issued for health.gov.ng only and does not cover the hfr subdomain — not fetched.
other_channels_checked.dataportal.ncdc.gov.ng/dataset/national-: NCDC data-portal listing of a 'National Health Facility Registry' dataset; host unreachable (connection refused) at capture time, so any licence it declares is unverified. A licence on a mirror would in any case not licence this registry-side export.

delivery.mechanism: Handed over as a file in the repository working tree. No download URL, no API response, no transfer receipt.
delivery.only_technical_evidence: The macOS quarantine attribute com.apple.quarantine names 'Numbers' as the application that produced the file, i.e. it was saved or exported from Apple Numbers. Correction to version 1 of this record, which attributed that to kMDItemWhereFroms: no kMDItemWhereFroms attribute exists on either copy, so there is no recorded download URL at all. The substance stands — the file is NOT a pristine upstream delivery: it passed through a spreadsheet application, which can silently alter number formatting, leading zeros, dates and encoding.

inferred_from_internal_timestamps.interpretation: A snapshot taken no earlier than 2026-07-21. These are the source system's own audit timestamps, not a declared dataset version.

licence.evidence: None. No licence file, no licence column, no terms-of-use statement accompanied the data.
licence.research_finding_2026_09_14: The identified source system's own site publishes no licence or terms of use; its only rights statement is 'Copyright ©2026 Federal Ministry of Health. All Rights Reserved' (see authoritative_source_research). So the position is worse than unknown: the one statement the presumed owner makes publicly reserves all rights, and permission must be obtained in writing. A prepared, unsent request is at facilities/source/nhf_authorization_request_draft_v1.md.
licence.consequence: Redistribution terms are unknown. The candidate artifact produced from this source must not be published, uploaded or served until licence or reuse permission is established in writing. This is a blocking, non-technical gate.

geographic_scope.claimed: nationwide (per the task brief, not per the data)
geographic_scope.observed: 33 of Nigeria's 36 states, plus the Federal Capital Territory. 682 distinct LGA names against Nigeria's 774.
geographic_scope.naming_variant: Akwa Ibom appears as 'Akwa-Ibom' (hyphenated), which differs from the spelling used by facilities 1.1 and by the standard state list.
geographic_scope.conclusion: The dataset is NOT nationwide on the evidence supplied. The gap is material and is reported in the coverage report rather than smoothed over.

documentation.mitigating_fact: The file resolves its own lookup tables: every *_id column is accompanied by a *_name column, and each id maps to exactly one name across all 31,390 rows (verified for state, lga, ward, facility_level, ownership, ownership_type and operational_status). Mappings are therefore derivable from the data itself and are machine-checked, not guessed.

coordinate_orientation.finding: The latitude and longitude columns are written the wrong way round for whole states. Tested against the repository's GRID3 facility points (CC BY 4.0, 51,022 points, all 37 states) as a boundary: every in-box row of the FCT, Kano, Katsina, Kwara, Taraba and Zamfara, and nearly every row of Jigawa, Kaduna, Niger and Benue, is outside its declared state as given and strictly inside it with the two values exchanged. Southern states are written correctly. The national bounding box cannot see a northern transposition because both values stay inside Nigeria.
coordinate_orientation.record_level_corroboration: GRID3 carries the NHFR facility id, so the same facility's independently published point can be compared: for rows the rule corrects, GRID3's point lies within 20 km of the exchanged pair 3,005 times and of the pair as given 2 times (5,611 joinable rows).
coordinate_orientation.treatment: coordinate_orientation_v1 (tools/facilities/geometry.py): a pair is exchanged only when it is outside its state as given and strictly inside it exchanged; the source values are kept on the record and every correction is listed in reports/facilities_coordinate_audit_v1.json. Both plausible, either uncertain, or GRID3 naming another state for the same facility: quarantined as ambiguous. Both outside: quarantined as invalid.
coordinate_orientation.not_established: Whether the transposition originated in the source system, in its export, or in the spreadsheet the supplied copy passed through (see delivery.only_technical_evidence). A pristine export from the owner would settle it; item AUTH-09 of the authorization checklist asks for one.

lga_id_scope.finding: lga_id is scoped to the LGA NAME, not to the state. Eleven ids appear under two states each. Six are homonymous LGA names that genuinely exist in both states (Nasarawa in Kano and Nasarawa; Obi in Benue and Nasarawa; Ifelodun and Irepodun in Kwara and Osun; Surulere in Lagos and Oyo; Bassa in Kogi and Plateau), with many rows and distinct coordinate clusters on each side. Five are single rows labelled Enugu that carry Abia LGA names and ids (Arochukwu, Isuikwuato, Ohafia, Umuahia North, Umuahia South); all five also carry 0,0 coordinates. The id->name direction stated above remains true; what does not hold is that an lga_id identifies one LGA.
lga_id_scope.consequence: (state_name, lga_name) is the unambiguous LGA key in this source. The candidate carries lga_id as a source identifier and documents that it must not be used alone. The registry unique_id's leading segment follows the (name-scoped) LGA, so it is inconsistent for the same rows and is not treated as a state signal.

unresolved_columns.facility_type_id: Three values (1, 2, 3) with NO accompanying name column, and its distribution does not match facility_level_id. Meaning unknown; carried to the unmapped report, not interpreted.
unresolved_columns.registration_status_id / license_status_: Name columns exist but the dominant value for both is literally 'Unknown'.

contact_fields_public_use.evidence: None. Nothing in the file or any accompanying document states that any contact field is intended for public distribution.

fields_present.phone_number: 30,513 of 31,390 rows populated. Positioned as a facility attribute, but public-use intent is undocumented.
fields_present.alternate_number: 5,999 populated. Same uncertainty, and the column contains non-phone junk (e.g. 'http://www.com').
fields_present.email_address: 6,966 populated. Contains a mix of institutional addresses and free text; some values look like individual mailboxes rather than facility addresses.

contact_fields_public_use.absent_note: All seven of those officer/workflow contact columns are empty across all 31,390 rows. Had they been populated they would have been personal staff contacts, not facility contacts, and would have been excluded.
contact_fields_public_use.decision: email_address and alternate_number are EXCLUDED from the candidate artifact: no documented public-use basis, and both carry evident data quality problems. phone_number is carried in a validated, normalised form because facilities 1.1 already surfaces a phone to users, but it is flagged for Product review before any public presentation or tel: action.

observed_signals.bulk_import: Every one of the 31,390 rows carries verify_note 'Auto-approved via bulk import', validate_note 'Auto-approved via bulk import' and publish_note 'Auto-published via bulk import'. 29,958 rows carry action 'CREATE FACILITY (BULK IMPORT)'.
observed_signals.meaning: No record in this dataset was individually verified. The verified/validated/published workflow fields record an automated bulk action, not human confirmation.
observed_signals.created_by: Two account identifiers only (5 and 145), consistent with two bulk loads rather than distributed data entry.

accuracy_and_completeness.conclusion: Completeness and accuracy are NOT established. The dataset is a bulk-imported registry snapshot with no per-record verification, three states missing and 92 LGAs unrepresented.
